intro: Temples, street food and rooftop nights. That is Bangkok in one line — but there is a lot more to it. This guide covers when to go, where to stay and what not to miss.

sections.heading: Why visit Bangkok
paragraphs: Bangkok (Southeast Asia) is known for its city, food and shopping experiences. Overall it is mid-range — comfortable stays and good food without overspending.

sections.heading: Best time to go
paragraphs: The best time to visit is November to February.

sections.heading: Top things to do
list: A canal boat ride through Thonburi

sections.heading: How to get there
paragraphs: Fly into Suvarnabhumi; there are many direct flights from India.

sections.heading: Insider tip
paragraphs: Use the river ferries — they beat the traffic and are cheap.

faq.q: When is the best time to visit Bangkok?

faq.a: Fly into Suvarnabhumi; there are many direct flights from India.

faq.q: Where should I stay in Bangkok?
faq.a: Popular choices: Sukhumvit for nightlife and transit; Riverside for luxury; Old Town for temples.
